Privacy Policy

The current tools are designed to work locally in your browser and avoid unnecessary collection.

Local tool inputs

The current tools process the values you enter in your browser. They do not require an account, and the site does not intentionally send tool inputs or generated output to a jquery.app application server.

Hosting and technical logs

jquery.app is published as a static website. Hosting providers, CDN services, browsers, and security systems may process standard request information such as IP address, user agent, referrer, requested URL, timestamps, and basic diagnostic data.

Cookies and analytics

jquery.app does not set cookies for the tools to work. If analytics, advertising, embedded media, or third-party widgets are added in the future, this policy will be updated before those services are enabled.

External links

Some pages may link to GitHub, documentation sites, browser tools, or other third-party resources. Those sites have their own privacy practices.
